$comment: Fiction template (phase 6). Same section model as nonfiction.json. No takeaways, scene breaks, chapters without subheadings. source: profile | owner | ai | app (see README.md).
name: Fiction

voice.perspective: set per book: first-person or close-third

wordTargets.note: Starting ranges for the owner to change per book; they are not market data.

titled.note: Chapter titles optional; when on, title case.

subheadings.note: Checked in code: any ## or ### heading in a chapter fails preflight item structure.template-rules (fiction.subheading).

sceneBreaks.note: Marker rendered centred; never a dash.
sceneBreaks.syntax: Write *** on its own line; the parser also accepts * * *. Exports print the theme glyph (default * * *) centred, and the next paragraph is not indented (D-042).

takeaways.note: Checked in code: a takeaways block or Key Takeaways heading fails preflight item structure.template-rules (fiction.takeaways).

rules.in-scene: Start inside action or a sensory moment.
rules.dialogue: Start on a line of dialogue.
rules.image: Start on a striking concrete image.
rules.question: Start on a question a character is asking.

bridgeToNext.rule: End on a turn, a question or a change, never a summary.

chapterRules.continuity: Every chapter receives the story bible (characters, places, timeline) and the used-already ledger.

continuityLedger.note: Ledger entries for characters and settings link back to the story bible (D-043, migration 0006). Kinds person and place stay valid for older books.

fields: characters (name, role, want, need, flaw, voice notes, appearance)

sections.title: Copyright
template: No part of this publication may be reproduced, distributed or transmitted in any form or by any means without the prior written permission of the author, except for brief quotations in reviews.

This is a work of fiction. Names, characters, places and incidents are the product of the author's imagination or are used fictitiously. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events is coincidental.

sections.title: Map
sections.content: A map of the story world, drawn or commissioned by the owner. Never AI text. Fantasy and romantasy books list it.

sections.title: Cast of Characters
sections.content: Short list of the main characters with one line each, from the story bible. The owner writes or approves it. Cosy mysteries list it.

sections.title: Glossary
sections.content: Invented words, places and terms of the story world, one or two sentences each, only as the chapters use them.

sections.title: Historical Note
sections.content: What is real and what is invented, in the owner's words. Never AI facts: historical claims need the owner's sources.

sections.title: A Recipe or Extra
sections.content: A recipe or small extra tied to the story, supplied by the owner.

sections.title: Story Notes
sections.content: A few lines from the owner on where each story came from.

sections.title: Acknowledgements
sections.content: Groups only unless names are in the profile.

sections.title: Also by {penName}
sections.content: Published books under this pen name only.

sections.title: Synopsis
sections.content: Full synopsis including the ending, kept with the blueprint, not printed.

publishing.content: Fiction still flags real-world medical, legal or safety instructions presented as fact, and real people named.

derivedFrom: draft: BOOK CREATION (title formulas for fiction)
draft: BOOK.md vision (genre engines, story bible)
